51 words for contempt & malice

The 51 words below run from Arrogant to Withholding. Its core words are Scornful, Hateful, Superior, Judgmental, and Petty. Some are mild and some are intense, so start with the one that feels closest and read the words around it. If nothing fits, the families on either side of it on the wheel, Relational Hurt and Anger, hold feelings that sit nearby.
